title: map-reduce InvalideUpdateError
observed_behavior: A conditional Send fan-out starts several num_pros tasks in one super-step. Each task returns a string for the plain state key num_p, with no reducer, so apply_writes raises InvalidUpdateError: Invalid update for channel num_p with values ['1123', '2123', '3123'].
structure_focus: Send fan-out to one node, then fan-in into an un-reduced (and undeclared) state key; intermediate node output schemas are not part of the graph state
notes: Open at collection, label-free body. Maintainer reply confirms the fix: add Annotated with a reducer to num_p. The graph mixes node return schemas (QueryOutputState, DataOutputState) that are never merged into OverallState, so num_p is not declared there at all; this is a state-schema/fan-in design problem, not a framework defect. The fixture keeps the Send fan-out, num_p writers and the num_pros1 downstream node.
